excerpt: With the Sumsub API, you can process the applicant data and documents submitted for verification through simple RESTful APIs.
Use Sandbox mode to test your integration before going live.
Sumsub’s Webhooks is a tool that allows you to automatically receive notifications for various events and changes related to your applicants’ verification process.
Use the MCP server to let AI agents perform Sumsub operations on your behalf, while keeping access controlled by your existing Sumsub role permissions.

A level is a sequence of steps that your applicants have to take to verify their identity. Each level may include document-based or selfie-based verification, Liveness & Face match, Short video fragment, Questionnaire, Payment methods, and many other checks.
Configure your AML screening settings to suit your needs by screening against targeted lists and categories that are relevant to your business, and adjust fuzziness levels to suit.
Tailor colors, styles, and step instructions to match your brand across Web and Mobile SDKs.
Grant your team members access to your Sumsub account.
Generate a security key or use biometric options to reduce the risk of account compromise.
With Reusable KYC, you can conclude an agreement with other Sumsub clients to share verification data, and enable applicant data reuse to complete your specific verification checks.
Instantly verify 14,000+ document types from 220+ countries and territories.
In under a second, it confirms the applicant is a real, live person (not a deepfake, AI-generated image, paper mask, photo of a screen, or doll) and matches them to the account and documents on file.
Open the Applicants page and select an applicant who passed the Liveness check. In the profile, navigate to the Liveness section and review the results.
